 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-2a5a8095.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Recolor full-width/full-height separator lines from their original color to 2."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separator_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v == row[0] for v in row):
            separator_cells.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        v = grid[0][c]
        if all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)):
            separator_cells.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    for r, c in separator_cells:
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
PY
